reviews: This product descales the kettle of a Waterwise distiller. It works fine, but it isn't worth buying because plain, inexpensive, white vinegar works just as well. I try not to let too much scale build up in the kettle, but even when I manage to go too long without descaling, I simply pour in undiluted vinegar, let it set overnight and voila! No more scale. When I use this product, it simply doesn't work nearly as well as the vinegar, so I have stopped using it.
